description: This Java class defines a RecyclerView ViewHolder for managing account items in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles binding account data to UI elements, displaying account info, and providing a context menu for account actions such as changing notes path, file suffix, or deleting the account.

classes.name: ManageAccountViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder that manages the display and interaction of account items in the account management list.

methods.name: ManageAccountViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewHolder with the provided item view.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds account data to the UI elements, sets up click listeners, and manages the account context menu based on API version support and whether the account is the current one.
